Solids made of planes, cylinders, cones, spheres, tori and surfaces of revolution, extrusion surfaces and B-spline surfaces are exact. When edge curves lie slightly off their surfaces, or weighted (rational) B-spline surfaces or surfaces that are not integrated (such as offset surfaces) are included, the estimated error is shown as ±.
